posts.title: The Absurdity of Desktop Linux
posts.description: "The year of Linux on the desktop". Nobody runs "Linux". They run Ubuntu, RedHat, Omarchy. Nobody runs Mach. They run macOS! Nobody runs NT. They run Windows 11! When is the year of NT on the desktop? Is Android a Linux distribution? People call Android an OS. Why? Why is Android an OS and Ubuntu a Linux distribution? Think about it. Really think about it! posts.description: I wrote a book in Word. That’s 72 000 words in Word. But I’ve stopped blogging, partly because writing markdown in my code editor just doesn’t vibe with me anymore.
